description: This file defines the BasketViewModelService class, which implements IBasketViewModelService to manage operations related to shopping baskets, such as retrieving, creating, and mapping basket data, as well as counting total items.

classes.name: BasketViewModelService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing basket view models, including retrieval, creation, and mapping operations.

methods.name: GetOrCreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Retrieves the existing basket for a user or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: CreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Creates a new basket for a specified user.

methods.name: GetBasketItems
methods.description: Maps basket items to their view models, including retrieving catalog item details and composing image URLs.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Transforms a Basket domain entity into its view model representation.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Returns the total count of items in a user's basket.
